who: Security-conscious developers and student teams who must vet a pip/npm package before adding it to their project to avoid supply-chain attacks
agent_work: An LLM agent in a 10-step loop that, inside a Celesto microVM, creates a clean baseline, installs the target package with network OFF, imports it, records files touched / processes spawned / attempted connections, and produces a risk report
proof_output: reports/detonation/<package>.json containing verdict, evidence list, and the sandbox name
